# Observer Patch Holography Papers

Release: r2006
Released: July 31, 2026

This page lists the first-party HTML and PDF URLs for the OPH paper stack.

## Deriving Standard Model Gauge Structure from Observer Overlap Consistency

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/standard-model-gauge-structure/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/standard-model-gauge-structure/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Peter Nguyen, Maarten Antonie Visser, David Matscheko
- Category: Gauge structure
- Summary: Two OPH gauge routes with distinct proof boundaries: categorical reconstruction from transported edge sectors and an incidence-derived finite current algebra with conditional Standard Model charges and tensor kernel. Physical global-form selection remains open.

## Deriving the Particle Zoo from Observer Consistency

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/particle-spectrum-from-observer-consistency/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/particle-spectrum-from-observer-consistency/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Maarten Antonie Visser, David Matscheko
- Category: Particles
- Summary: The OPH particle-spectrum continuation. It treats fine-structure closure, electroweak transport, selected-class quarks, the exact icosahedral charged-family carrier and its target-informed completion conjecture, the engineered digital CFQ schema audit, the conditional nature/pole transport boundary, neutrino branches, and status-separated hadron checks.

## From Observer Consensus to Standard Physics

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/from-observer-consensus-to-standard-physics/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/from-observer-consensus-to-standard-physics/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Ben Cassie, Peter Nguyen, Maarten Antonie Visser, Kale Arnav Anirudha, David Matscheko, Jonathan Hill, William T. Glynn
- Category: Flagship introduction
- Summary: A standalone introduction to Observer Patch Holography: finite self-reading patches, public quantum records, Lorentzian geometry, Einstein dynamics, and Standard Model structure.

## Observers Are All You Need

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observers-are-all-you-need/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observers-are-all-you-need/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Ben Cassie, Peter Nguyen, Maarten Antonie Visser, Kale Arnav Anirudha, David Matscheko, Jonathan Hill, William T. Glynn
- Category: Theory of everything
- Summary: OPH builds physics from finite public records on horizon-screen cuts. The paper presents the observer-first reconstruction of spacetime, gravity, Standard Model structure, cosmology, particles, records, and simulation-theory interpretation.

## Paradise as Fixed-Point Consensus

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/paradise-as-fixed-point-consensus/

## Reality as a Consensus Protocol

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/reality-as-consensus-protocol/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/reality-as-consensus-protocol/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Kai Xue, Kale Arnav Anirudha, David Matscheko, Jonathan Hill
- Category: Simulation theory
- Summary: The OPH fixed-point consensus paper. It formulates observer patches, overlap-visible records, repair moves, Lyapunov descent, quotient normal forms, and obstruction classes.

## Recovering Observer Spacetime and Einstein Dynamics from Overlap Consistency

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observer-spacetime-einstein-dynamics/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/observer-spacetime-einstein-dynamics/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Mario Poneder, Kai Xue, Peter Nguyen, Maarten Antonie Visser, David Matscheko
- Category: Gravity
- Summary: The full OPH derivation chain from finite overlap records through the celestial screen, modular Lorentz kinematics, a conditional four-dimensional event manifold, local stress reconstruction, and the conditional Einstein equation.

## Screen Microphysics and Observer Synchronization

- HTML: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/screen-microphysics-and-observer-synchronization/
- PDF: https://floatingpragma.io/oph/papers/screen-microphysics-and-observer-synchronization/paper.pdf
- Authors: Bernhard Mueller, Alexander Osika, Kai Xue, Ben Cassie, Maarten Antonie Visser, David Matscheko
- Category: Screen physics
- Summary: The fixed-cutoff OPH microphysics paper. It develops finite overlap-facing patch carriers, the twelve-port screen-sieve theorem, the A5/C3 face-corner bundle, the formal CFQ central-record model and its physical-selection boundary, measurement surfaces, observer backup, synchronization, and hardware-evidence rules.
